sources.title: Credibility Consideration for Digital Twins in Manufacturing
sources.titleEn: Credibility Consideration for Digital Twins in Manufacturing
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 柔性製造單元排程
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：驗證集未用來調參，bias與RMSE都有，適用用途及失效條件明確。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Held-out data were not tuned on, both bias andRMSE are reported, and intended use/failure conditions are explicit.
related.difference: 在每件先M1後M2、每台同時一件的限制下比較完工時間，而非只排序單機工時。
related.differenceEn: Compare makespan under M1-before-M2 and one-job-per-machine constraints, not single-machine times alone.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 殘差ri=預測−量測；bias=平均r，RMSE=√[平均(r²)]；零bias可由正負誤差抵消。 合成保留資料四個週期時間殘差[1,−1,2,−2] s，不使用它們調參。 bias=0 s，RMSE=√(10/4)=1.58114 s；平均零不代表逐筆正確。
第二機台完工C2,j=max(C1,j,C2,j−1)+p2,j；此遞迴同時維持工件及機台先序。 合成工時min：A=(2,5)、B=(4,1)、C=(3,3)，無換線時間、不可中斷。 順序A-C-B：M1完工2,5,9；M2完工7,10,11，makespan=11 min。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Residualri=prediction−measurement; bias=meanr andRMSE=sqrt(mean(r_i²)); opposite errors can cancel bias. Four synthetic held-out cycle-time residuals[1,−1,2,−2] s, not used for tuning. Bias 0 s, RMSE 1.58114 s; zero mean does not imply accurate individual predictions.

Second-machine completion C2, j=max(C1, j, C2, j−1)+p 2, j enforces job and machine precedence. Synthetic times in minutes: A=(2,5), B=(4,1), C=(3,3), with no setup or preemption. OrderA-C-B gives M1 completion 2,5,9 and M2 completion 7,10,11; makespan 11 min.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Universal Robots UR5 協作手臂
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：驗證集未用來調參，bias與RMSE都有，適用用途及失效條件明確。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Held-out data were not tuned on, both bias andRMSE are reported, and intended use/failure conditions are explicit.
related.difference: 理解延遲距離和減速距離需相加，並識別簡化模型的適用界限。
related.differenceEn: Add delay distance to braking distance and identify the simplified model boundary.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 殘差ri=預測−量測；bias=平均r，RMSE=√[平均(r²)]；零bias可由正負誤差抵消。 合成保留資料四個週期時間殘差[1,−1,2,−2] s，不使用它們調參。 bias=0 s，RMSE=√(10/4)=1.58114 s；平均零不代表逐筆正確。
d=vT+v²/(2a)，第一項為延遲，第二項為等減速度停止距離。；教學滑塊 v=0.50 m/s、T=0.20 s、a=1.0 m/s²，完全離線計算。；d=0.5×0.2+0.5²/(2×1)=0.225 m。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Residualri=prediction−measurement; bias=meanr andRMSE=sqrt(mean(r_i²)); opposite errors can cancel bias. Four synthetic held-out cycle-time residuals[1,−1,2,−2] s, not used for tuning. Bias 0 s, RMSE 1.58114 s; zero mean does not imply accurate individual predictions.
d=vT+v²/(2a): delay travel plus constant-deceleration braking distance.; Offline teaching slider: v=0.50 m/s, T=0.20 s, a=1.0 m/s².; d=0.5×0.2+0.5²/(2×1)=0.225 m.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
